findings.observation: The displayed level is 4, Adventuring, Tanvu, Kojan. Details lists Charred Corpse as starter, location -22262, -44361, 231, Shang Village series and Oki as hand-in. These are attributed archive claims; the four recorded disagreements include starts npc and level, so neither is a resolved historical value.

The primary objective is Discover what happened to Oki. Introductory prose and the alternate fandom objective describe following ravaged items northeast along the beach, with the alternate account mentioning a charred corpse. The notes mention Kujuko Scavenger Level 4 (Demonic, Imp, 2 dot, aggro), but contain no explicit kill instruction or count. No operative kill step is inferred.

Notes place Oki at -16529, -49889, 194 in Tanvu (-19, 6). This context remains separate from the starter Details location. The latter equals the corpse note coordinate on Finding Oki; textual agreement does not verify a spawn or interaction trigger.

Previous Finding Oki reciprocates that page Next Avenging Oki. Next is displayed as Oki's Jewels. The page explicitly records four disagreements: level and starts npc attributed to the Forgotten Horde wiki; next quest and prev quest attributed to silkyvenom. The disagreement links are query URLs and were not requested. Their alternate values are not supplied here.

Repeatable No is explicit. Coin reward 30 has no printed denomination and remains a literal observation, not copper. Turtleshell bag is linked as a reward; its embedded tooltip states Soulbound, Container (6 Slots), Required Level: 4 Adventuring, Item Level: 9 and a class list. These are embedded page observations, not fetched item-page or screenshot verification. The binding trigger remains unknown.
The Telon Project source attribution and fandom variant are retained as transcribed archive evidence. Their original pages were not fetched, and mirror lineage is not independent corroboration.
